bias.zh: 短线偏多 · 测试重要阻力

read.en: Tesla has climbed back above its 5, 10, 30 and 100-day averages, with the 5-day leading. MACD crossed above its signal on Oct 6 and the histogram is still growing, RSI is 60, and Parabolic SAR flipped bullish on Oct 5. The 30-day average has turned up, but the 100-day is still edging lower and price remains just under the 200-day average ($391).
read.zh: 特斯拉已重新站上 5 日、10 日、30 日和 100 日均线，5 日线领先。MACD 于 10月6日上穿信号线，柱体仍在放大，RSI 为 60，抛物线 SAR 于 10月5日转为看多。30 日均线已拐头向上，但 100 日均线仍小幅下行，股价仍略低于 200 日均线（$391）。

read.en: The key zone is $388–391. Price has stalled near $388 eight times since March, and the 200-day average sits just above it. A daily close above $391 would be the first since early July and would target $418 and then $438. Failure here keeps Tesla in its $342–388 range; first support is the 30-day average and June pivot near $366, then $354.
read.zh: 关键区域在 $388–391。自3月以来股价八次在 $388 附近受阻，200 日均线就在其上方。若日线收盘站上 $391，将是7月初以来首次，目标看 $418，再看 $438。若在此受阻，特斯拉仍将运行于 $342–388 区间；首个支撑为 30 日均线及6月转折点（约 $366），其次 $354。

r.en: $388 cap (8 touches since March) plus the 200-day average
r.zh: $388 压力（3月以来八次触及）及200日均线
